text: The dataset is a synthetic telecom usage dataset designed to simulate application-level internet consumption patterns. It is not real customer data.
Local/pseudo-distributed Big Data implementation using HDFS, Spark, Hive and Spark MLlib.
Usage anomaly detection only, not fraud detection. There are no ground-truth anomaly labels, so accuracy, precision, recall, F1 and ROC-AUC are not reported.
Category-specific IQR thresholds were calculated during Stage 16. A session is flagged when its data consumption exceeds the threshold for its app category.

Customer clusters are descriptive aggregate usage segments for repeat customers. Shuffled-session controls produced similar silhouette values, so these clusters are not strong evidence of persistent individual customer behavior.
Session-level clusters should be interpreted descriptively. Clusters 0 and 2 had similar average data consumption and differed mainly in session duration.
